46500.commentary: (VINa) pucchiyamāno'ti idañ'hi karaṇ'atthe paccattavacanaṃ. atha vā pucchaṃ kurumāno pucchiyamāno'ti evam'p'ettha attho daṭṭhabbo.

examples.text: na dhammo bhāsitabbo. kiṃ kāraṇā āgato'sī'ti pucchiyamāno jānāhi, āvuso'ti vattabbo. sace āsane vā nisīdati, āmisaṃ vā paṭiggaṇhāti, dhammaṃ vā bhāsati, ṭhānaṃ bhañjati.

anāpatti, kattha demā'ti pucchīyamāno, yattha tumhākaṃ deyyadhammo paribhogaṃ vā labheyya paṭisaṅkhāraṃ vā labheyya ciraṭṭhitiko vā assa yattha vā pana tumhākaṃ cittaṃ pasīdati tattha dethā'ti bhaṇati, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.
so taṃ purisaṃ tassa gāmassa vā nigamassa vā khematañ'ca subhikkhatañ'ca app'ābādhatañ'ca puccheyya
no ce'pi uccākulā pabbajito hoti, so ca hoti dhamm'ānudhammappaṭipanno sāmīcippaṭipanno anudhammacārī, so pujjo, so tattha pāsaṃso'ti.
kiñ'c'āpi so, bhikkhave, bhikkhu taṃ piṇḍapātaṃ bhuñjitvā jighacchādubbalyaṃ paṭivinodetvā evaṃ taṃ rattin'divaṃ vītināmeyya, atha kho asu'y'eva me purimo bhikkhu pujjataro ca pāsaṃsataro ca

46504.meaning1: more commendable; more praiseworthy; more laudable

examples.text: kiñ'c'āpi so, bhikkhave, bhikkhu taṃ piṇḍapātaṃ bhuñjitvā jighacchādubbalyaṃ paṭivinodetvā evaṃ taṃ rattin'divaṃ vītināmeyya, atha kho asu'y'eva me purimo bhikkhu pujjataro ca pāsaṃsataro ca
seyyathā'pi, bhante, rajoharaṇaṃ sucim'pi… puñchati, na ca tena rajoharaṇaṃ aṭṭīyati vā harāyati vā jigucchati vā.
seyyathā'pi, bhante, rajoharaṇaṃ sucim'pi puñchati asucim'pi puñchati gūthagatam'pi
upāhanā puñchantena paṭhamaṃ sukkhena coḷakena puñchitabbā, pacchā allena. upāhanāpuñchanacoḷakaṃ dhovitvā ekam'antaṃ vissajjetabbaṃ.

nivāto nāma nīcamanatā nivātavuttitā, yāya samannāgato puggalo nihatamāno nihatadappo pādapuñchanakacoḷasadiso chinnavisāṇa-usabhasamo uddhaṭadāṭhasappasamo ca hutvā saṇho sakhilo sukhasambhāso hoti, ayaṃ nivāto.
upāhanā puñchantena paṭhamaṃ sukkhena coḷakena puñchitabbā, pacchā allena. upāhanāpuñchanacoḷakaṃ dhovitvā ekam'antaṃ vissajjetabbaṃ.

46514.meaning1: having wiped off; having cleaned away
46514.commentary: (DNa) atha kho, ānanda, subhaddā devī assūni puñchitvā'ti devī ekam'antaṃ gantvā roditvā kanditvā assūni puñchitvā etadavoca.

examples.text: evaṃ vutte, ānanda, subhaddā devī parodi assūni pavattesi. atha kho, ānanda, subhaddā devī assūni puñchitvā rājānaṃ mahāsudassanaṃ etadavoca
kiṃ nu satto'ti paccesi, māra diṭṭhigataṃ nu te, suddhasaṅkhārapuñjo'yaṃ, na'y'idha satt'upalabbhati.
araññaṃ rukkhamūlaṃ pabbataṃ kandaraṃ giriguhaṃ susānaṃ vanappatthaṃ abbhokāsaṃ palālapuñjaṃ
puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu seyyathā'pi passeyya sarīraṃ sivathikāya chaḍḍitaṃ aṭṭhikāni puñjakitāni terovassikāni

46519.commentary: (SNa) puññan'ti puññacetanā, sā hi arūpattā pariharituṃ na sakkā'ti.

examples.text: abhittharetha kalyāṇe, pāpā cittaṃ nivāraye, dandhañ'hi karoto puññaṃ, pāpasmiṃ ramatī mano.
sīlaṃ yāva jarā sādhu, saddhā sādhu patiṭṭhitā, paññā narānaṃ ratanaṃ, puññaṃ corehi dūharan'ti.
lābhī c'amhi cīvara-piṇḍapāta-sen'āsana-gilānappaccaya-bhesajjaparikkhārānaṃ, ime pan'aññe bhikkhū appapuññā app'esakkhā na lābhino cīvara-piṇḍapāta-sen'āsana-gilānappaccaya-bhesajjaparikkhārānan'ti.

mahantañ'ca taṃ padumavanañ'cā'ti mahāpadumavanaṃ, mahantī ca sā nadī cā'ti mahānadī, mahanto ca so maṇi cā'ti mahāmaṇi, mahanto ca so gahapatiko cā'ti mahāgahapatiko, mahantañ'ca taṃ dhanañ'cā'ti mahādhanaṃ, mahanto ca so puñño cā'ti mahāpuñño.

46521.meaning1: who has made merit; who has done good; has gained spiritual wealth

examples.text: patirūpe vase dese, ariyamittakaro siyā, sammāpaṇidhisampanno, pubbe puññakato naro, dhaññaṃ dhanaṃ yaso kitti, sukhañ'c'etaṃ'dhivattatī'ti.
rājā satthu vacanaṃ sutvā, aho, bhante, bhāriyaṃ kammaṃ, ettake nāma bhoge vijjamāne n'eva attanā paribhuñji, na tumhādise buddhe dhuravihāre viharante puññakammaṃ akāsī'ti āha.
ye gahaṭṭhā puññakarā, sīlavanto upāsakā, dhammena dāraṃ posenti, te namassāmi mātalī'ti.

46524.meaning1: desiring merit; wishing to do meritorious deeds

examples.text: kassapassa, bhikkhave, kulāni upasaṅkamato kulesu cittaṃ na sajjati na gayhati na bajjhati, labhantu lābhakāmā, puññakāmā karontu puññānī'ti, yathāsakena lābhena attamano hoti sumano, evaṃ paresaṃ lābhena attamano hoti sumano.
evam'ev'āhaṃ puññakāmo, disvā khettavar'uttamaṃ, yadi tattha kāraṃ na karomi, n'āhaṃ puññena atthiko.

46525.meaning1: basis for good deeds; grounds for making merit
46525.commentary: (ANa) puññakiriyāni ca tāni tesaṃ tesaṃ ānisaṃsānaṃ vatthūni cā'ti puññakiriyavatthūni.

examples.text: evaṃ sante, kho, māṇava, brāhmaṇānaṃ idaṃ chaṭṭhaṃ puññakiriyavatthu hoti, yadidaṃ anukampājātikan'ti.
appamādaṃ pasaṃsanti, puññakiriyāsu paṇḍitā, appamatto ubho atthe, adhiggaṇhāti paṇḍito.

46529.meaning1: mountain of merit; mass of good

examples.text: puññakhandhā'ti katakusalatāya puññakkhandhā viya.

46530.meaning1: exhaustion of merit; depletion of spiritual wealth
46530.commentary: (DNa) āyukkhayā vā puññakkhayā vā'ti ye uḷāraṃ puññakammaṃ katvā yattha katthaci app'āyuke devaloke nibbattanti, te attano puññabalena ṭhātuṃ na sakkonti, tassa pana devalokassa āyuppamāṇen'eva cavantī'ti āyukkhayā cavantī'ti vuccanti. ye pana parittaṃ puññakammaṃ katvā dīgh'āyukadevaloke nibbattanti, te yāvat'āyukaṃ ṭhātuṃ na sakkonti, antarā'va cavantī'ti puññakkhayā cavantī'ti vuccanti.

examples.text: atha kho aññataro satto āyukkhayā vā puññakkhayā vā ābhassarakāyā cavitvā suññaṃ brahmavimānaṃ upapajjati. so tattha hoti manomayo pītibhakkho sayaṃpabho antalikkhacaro subhaṭṭhāyī, ciraṃ dīgham'addhānaṃ tiṭṭhati.
devalokato hi devaputtā āyukkhayena puññakkhayena āhārakkhayena kopenā'ti catūhi kāraṇehi cavanti.
evam'evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, aṭṭhahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu āhuneyyo hoti pāhuneyyo dakkhiṇeyyo añjalikaraṇīyo anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassa.
sabbe'p'ime gāmavāsino maṃ hanantu vā bandhantu vā, īdise puññakkhette pānīyadānaṃ dassāmi evā'ti
upaṭṭhite deyyadhamme, puññ'atthassa jigīsato, santesu paṭhamaṃ dinnā, vipulā hoti dakkhiṇā.
ārogy'atthāya moceti, sukh'atthāya moceti, bhesajj'atthāya moceti, dān'atthāya moceti, puññ'atthāya moceti, yaññ'atthāya moceti, sagg'atthāya moceti

46534.commentary: (VVa) kesan'ti āha puññ'atthikānaṃ vipulapphalesinan'ti, puññena atthikānaṃ vipulaṃ mahantaṃ puññaphalaṃ icchantānaṃ, tathāgato eva lokassa puññakkhettan'ti dasseti. (CPa) puññ'atthiko'ti puññena atthiko, dhammacchandayutto.

examples.text: pucchām'ahaṃ gotamaṃ vadaññuṃ, (iti māgho māṇavo) kāsāyavāsiṃ agahaṃ carantaṃ, yo yācayogo dānapati gahaṭṭho, puññ'atthiko yajati puññapekkho, dadaṃ paresaṃ idha annapānaṃ, kathaṃ hutaṃ yajamānassa sujjhe.

46535.meaning1: stream of merit; shower of goodness; rain of fortune

examples.text: āmodamāno pakireti, detha dethā'ti bhāsati, taṃ hi'ssa gajjitaṃ hoti, devass'eva pavassato, sā puññadhārā vipulā, dātāraṃ abhivassatī'ti.

katamesaṃ tiṇṇaṃ? dāyakassa puññ'antarāyakaro hoti, paṭiggāhakānaṃ lābh'antarāyakaro hoti, pubb'eva kho pan'assa attā khato ca hoti upahato ca. yo kho, vaccha, paraṃ dānaṃ dadantaṃ vāreti so imesaṃ tiṇṇaṃ antarāyakaro hoti, tiṇṇaṃ pāripanthiko.

46537.meaning1: doing good and evil; merit and sin

examples.text: samitāvi pahāya puññapāpaṃ, virajo ñatvā imaṃ parañ'ca lokaṃ, jātimaraṇaṃ upātivatto, samaṇo tādi pavuccate tath'attā.
anavassutacittassa, ananvāhatacetaso, puññapāpapahīnassa, n'atthi jāgarato bhayaṃ.

46538.meaning1: experiencing the fruit of meritorious and wicked deeds

examples.text: sabbe sattā marissanti, maraṇ'antañ'hi jīvitaṃ, yathākammaṃ gamissanti, puññapāpaphal'ūpagā, nirayaṃ pāpakamm'antā, puññakammā ca suggatiṃ.

46539.meaning1: looking for merit; seeking spiritual wealth
46539.commentary: (SNa) puññapekkhānan'ti puññaṃ icchantānaṃ puññ'atthikānaṃ. (ANa) puññapekkhānan'ti puññaṃ olokentānaṃ gavesantānaṃ. (DHPa) puññapekkho'ti puññaṃ icchanto.

examples.text: yaṃ kiñci yiṭṭhaṃ va hutaṃ va loke, saṃvaccharaṃ yajetha puññapekkho, sabbam'pi taṃ na catubhāgam'eti, abhivādanā ujugatesu seyyo.
aññena ca kevalinaṃ mah'esiṃ, khīṇ'āsavaṃ kukkuccavūpasantaṃ, annena pānena upaṭṭhahassu, khettaṃ hi taṃ puññapekkhassa hotī'ti.

46540.grammar: adj, comp, dat pl of puññapekkha, irreg form of puññapekkhānaṃ
46540.meaning1: for (those) looking for merit; for (those) seeking spiritual wealth
46540.construction:
puñña + pekkha + ānaṃ > āna
puññapekkha + āna

examples.text: yajamānānaṃ manussānaṃ, puññapekkhāna pāṇinaṃ, karotaṃ opadhikaṃ puññaṃ, kattha dinnaṃ mahapphalan'ti.

46541.meaning1: way of making merit; beneficial practice

examples.text: yo ca yajāpeti sabbe te anekasārīrikaṃ puññappaṭipadaṃ paṭipannā honti, yadidaṃ yaññ'ādhikaraṇaṃ.

46542.meaning1: result of meritorious deeds; fruit of good works

examples.text: ettakaṃ puññaphalaṃ tumhākaṃ pattiṃ katvā dammi, mayhaṃ kumud'uppalehi saddhiṃ aruṇavatīmattikaṃ āharathā'ti tikkhattuṃ anussāvesi. tattha adhivattho nāgarājā taṃ saddaṃ sutvā mahallakavesena tassa santikaṃ gantvā kiṃ vadesī'ti āha.

46543.meaning1: arising of good consequences of merit

46546.meaning1: meritorious; related to merit; connected with good deeds

examples.text: sammādiṭṭhiṃ'p'ahaṃ, bhikkhave, dvayaṃ vadāmi. atthi, bhikkhave, sammādiṭṭhi sāsavā puññabhāgiyā upadhivepakkā, atthi, bhikkhave, sammādiṭṭhi ariyā anāsavā lok'uttarā magg'aṅgā.
katamo ca, bhikkhave, kāmānaṃ vipāko? yaṃ kho, bhikkhave, kāmayamāno tajjaṃ tajjaṃ attabhāvaṃ abhinibbatteti puññabhāgiyaṃ vā apuññabhāgiyaṃ vā, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, kāmānaṃ vipāko.

46547.meaning1: who has a share in the merit

examples.text: satthā suddhavatthaṃ pasāresi, dhātuyo tattha patiṃsu. tā patte pakkhipitvā catumahāpathe thūpaṃ kāresi mahājano vanditvā puññabhāgī bhavissatī'ti.

46551.meaning1: accumulation of merit; amassing of spiritual wealth

examples.text: sāvako'pi khīṇ'āsavo sāvakabodhiyā hetubhūte puññasambhāre sambharanto pubbayogaṃ pubbacariyaṃ gatapaccāgatavattaṃ pūrento carimabhave nibbattanto anukkamena viññutaṃ patvā saṃsāre ādīnavaṃ disvā pabbajjāya cetayamāno pabbajjaṃ matthakaṃ pāpetvā sīl'ādīni paripūrento dhutadhamme samādāya…
tassa hi pātubhāvā ratanāni pātubhavanti. pātubhūtehi pana tehi saddhiṃ paripakke puññasambhāre so saṃyujjati, tadā lokassa tesu pātubhāvacittaṃ uppajjati. bahulavacanato c'āpi yuttam'ev'etaṃ.
lokkhasammatā hi, bho gotama, bāhukā nadī bahujanassa, puññasammatā hi, bho gotama, bāhukā nadī bahujanassa, bāhukāya pana nadiyā bahujano pāpakammaṃ kataṃ pavāhetī'ti.

yāvatā, bho, rañño pasenadissa kosalassa vijitaṃ yattha ca rājā pasenadi kosalo issariy'ādhipaccaṃ rajjaṃ kāreti, pahoti tattha rājā pasenadi kosalo samaṇaṃ vā brāhmaṇaṃ vā puññavantaṃ vā apuññavantaṃ vā brahmacariyavantaṃ vā abrahmacariyavantaṃ vā tamhā ṭhānā cāvetuṃ vā pabbājetuṃ vā'ti.

46554.meaning1: fruit of merit; results of good deeds

examples.text: so khv'āhaṃ, bhante, evaṃ dīgharattaṃ katānaṃ puññānaṃ evaṃ dīgharattaṃ katānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pariyantaṃ n'ādhigacchāmi, ettakaṃ puññan'ti vā ettako puññavipāko'ti vā ettakaṃ sagge ṭhātabban'ti vā'ti.

46555.meaning1: makes merit; performs good deeds; does good works

examples.text: devassa kho dānaṃ dīyati, amhākaṃ dānaṃ na dīyati. sādhu mayam'pi devaṃ nissāya dānāni dadeyyāma, puññāni kareyyāmā'ti.
accenti kālā tarayanti rattiyo, vayoguṇā anupubbaṃ jahanti, etaṃ bhayaṃ maraṇe pekkhamāno, puññāni kayirātha sukh'āvahānī'ti.
atthāyaṃ itarā pajā, puññābhāgā'ti me mano, saṅkhātuṃ no'pi sakkomi, musāvādassa ottappanti.

46558.meaning1: meritorious intention; positive karmic formations; wholesome intentional activity
46558.commentary: (PMa) puññ'ābhisaṅkhāro'ti-ādīsu punāti attano kārakaṃ, pūreti c'assa ajjhāsayaṃ, pujjañ'ca bhavaṃ nibbattetī'ti puññaṃ, abhisaṅkharoti vipākaṃ kaṭattārūpañ'cā'ti abhisaṅkhāro, puññaṃ abhisaṅkhāro puññ'ābhisaṅkhāro.

examples.text: yato kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno avijjā pahīnā hoti vijjā uppannā, so avijjāvirāgā vijj'uppādā n'eva puññ'ābhisaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti na apuññ'ābhisaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti na āneñj'ābhisaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti.

46559.meaning1: stream of merit; meritorious result; outflow of goodness
46559.meaning2: accumulation of merit, outcome of merit
46559.commentary: (SNa) puññ'ābhisandā kusal'ābhisandā'ti puññanadiyo kusalanadiyo. (SNt) avicchedena niccappavattiyamānāni puññāni abhisandan'aṭṭhena puññ'ābhisandā'ti vuttā, tena puññanadiyo'ti attho vutto.

examples.text: ayaṃ paṭhamo puññ'ābhisando kusal'ābhisando sukhass'āhāro.

46561.meaning2: Chapter 4 of the Sotāpattisaṃyuttaṃ, Book 5 of the Saṃyutta Nikāya

46564.meaning1: headed according to one's merit; (or) headed towards a meritorious destination
46564.commentary: (SNa) puññ'ūpagaṃ hoti viññāṇan'ti kammaviññāṇaṃ kammapuññena upagataṃ sampayuttaṃ hoti, vipākaviññāṇaṃ vipākapuññena.

examples.text: avijjāgato yaṃ, bhikkhave, purisapuggalo puññaṃ ce saṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti, puññ'ūpagaṃ hoti viññāṇaṃ. apuññaṃ ce saṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti, apuññ'ūpagaṃ hoti viññāṇaṃ.

46565.meaning2: container (usually made of leaves), pocket, basket

examples.text: tasmā patta-puṭassa-eva, ñatvā sampākam'attano, asante n'upaseveyya, sante seveyya paṇḍito, asanto nirayaṃ nenti, santo pāpenti suggatin'ti.
yathārūpaṃ parisaṃ alaṃ yojanagaṇanāni'pi dassanāya gantuṃ api puṭ'aṃsenā'pi, tathārūpo ayaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhusaṅgho.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, puriso kāḷakaṃ vatthaṃ paridhāya kese pakiritvā bhasmapuṭaṃ khandhe āropetvā mahājanakāyaṃ upasaṅkamitvā

46567.meaning1: container; wrap; pocket (usually made of a folded leaf)
46567.meaning2: container (usually made of leaves), pocket, basket

examples.text: atha kho, ānanda, kikī kāsirājā tassā rattiyā accayena sake nivesane paṇītaṃ khādanīyaṃ bhojanīyaṃ paṭiyādāpetvā paṇḍupuṭakassa sālino vigatakāḷakaṃ anekasūpaṃ anekabyañjanaṃ

46572.meaning1: opening of packages; place where goods are distributed
46572.commentary: (DNa) puṭabhedanan'ti bhaṇḍapuṭabhedanaṭṭhānaṃ, bhaṇḍabhaṇḍikānaṃ mocanaṭṭhānan'ti vuttaṃ hoti. sakalajambudīpe aladdhabhaṇḍam'pi hi idh'eva labhissanti, aññattha vikkayena agacchantam'pi ca idh'eva gamissati. tasmā idh'eva puṭaṃ bhindissantī'ti attho. catūsu hi dvāresu cattāri sabhāyaṃ ekan'ti evaṃ divase divase pañcasatasahassāni uṭṭhahissantī'ti dasseti.

examples.text: yāvatā, ānanda, ariyaṃ āyatanaṃ yāvatā vaṇippatho idaṃ agganagaraṃ bhavissati pāṭaliputtaṃ puṭabhedanaṃ.

46573.meaning2: shoulder bag; knapsack on the sholder; bag carrying provisions on journeys
46573.commentary: (ANa) puṭ'aṃsenā'ti'pi pāṭho. tass'attho, puṭo aṃse assā'ti puṭ'aṃso, tena puṭ'aṃsena, aṃsena pātheyyapuṭaṃ vahantenā'pī'ti

examples.text: yathārūpaṃ parisaṃ alaṃ yojanagaṇanāni'pi dassanāya gantuṃ api puṭ'aṃsenā'pi, tathārūpo ayaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhusaṅgho.

46574.commentary: (MNa) puṭ'osenā'pī'ti puṭ'osaṃ vuccati pātheyyaṃ. taṃ pātheyyaṃ gahetvā'pi upasaṅkamituṃ yuttam'evā'ti attho. puṭ'aṃsenā'ti'pi pāṭho, tass'attho puṭo aṃse assā'ti puṭ'aṃso, tena puṭ'aṃsena, aṃse pātheyyapuṭaṃ vahantenā'pī'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: tathārūpo ayaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhusaṅgho, tathārūpā ayaṃ, bhikkhave, parisā yathārūpaṃ parisaṃ alaṃ yojanagaṇanāni dassanāya gantuṃ puṭ'osenā'pi.
anagāriy'upetassa, bhikkhācariyaṃ jigīsato, muni pabrūhi me puṭṭho, moneyyaṃ uttamaṃ padaṃ.
evaṃ puṭṭhā, bhikkhave, aññatitthiyā paribbājakā na c'eva sampāyissanti, uttariñ'ca vighātaṃ āpajjissanti. taṃ kissa hetu? yathā taṃ, bhikkhave, avisayasmiṃ.
middhī yadā hoti mahagghaso ca, niddāyitā samparivattasāyī, mahāvarāho'va nivāpapuṭṭho, punappunaṃ gabbham'upeti mando.
sūro yathā rājakhādāya puṭṭho, abhigajjam'eti paṭisūram'icchaṃ, yen'eva so tena palehi sūra, pubb'eva n'atthi yadidaṃ yudhāya.

46577.meaning1: coming to ask; arriving to question

examples.text: kathaṃ satassa carato, viññāṇaṃ uparujjhati, bhagavantaṃ puṭṭhum'āgamma, taṃ suṇoma vaco tava.
kati lokasmiṃ pajjotā, yehi loko pakāsati, bhagavantaṃ puṭṭhum'āgamma, kathaṃ jānemu taṃ mayan'ti.
sutvān'ahaṃ vīram'akāmakāmiṃ, ogh'ātigaṃ puṭṭhum'akāmam'āgamaṃ, santipadaṃ brūhi sahajanetta, yathātacchaṃ bhagavā brūhi me taṃ.
kathaṃ satassa carato, viññāṇaṃ uparujjhati, bhagavantaṃ puṭṭhum'āgamma, taṃ suṇoma vaco tava.
evaṃ puṭṭho'haṃ, āvuso, evaṃ byākareyyaṃ, viññāṇaṃ aniccaṃ. yadaniccaṃ taṃ dukkhaṃ, yaṃ dukkhaṃ taṃ niruddhaṃ tadatthaṅ'gatan'ti. evaṃ puṭṭho'haṃ, āvuso, evaṃ byākareyyan'ti.

46583.meaning1: (comm) part of the Avīci hell where one must stay a puṇḍarika-count in duration

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhu, vīsati kumudā nirayā, evam'eko sogandhiko nirayo. seyyathā'pi, bhikkhu, vīsati sogandhikā nirayā, evam'eko uppalanirayo. seyyathā'pi, bhikkhu, vīsati uppalā nirayā, evam'eko puṇḍariko nirayo.
tass'uddānaṃ puṇḍarī-aggisaha-kathināmo, dīghanakho puna bhāradvājagotto, sandaka-udāyi-muṇḍikaputto, maṇiko tathākaccāno varavaggo.

46585.meaning1: lotus; (specifically) white lotus; (comm) lotus with less than one hundred petals; (or) pink lotus
46585.commentary: (ANa) ettha ca setarattanīlesu yaṃkiñci uppalam'eva, ūnakasatapattaṃ puṇḍarīkaṃ, satapattaṃ padumaṃ. pattaniyamaṃ vā vinā'pi setaṃ padumaṃ, rattaṃ puṇḍarīkan'ti ayam'ettha vinicchayo.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi bhikkhave uppaliniyaṃ vā paduminiyaṃ vā puṇḍarīkiniyaṃ vā app'ekaccāni uppalāni vā padumāni vā puṇḍarīkāni vā
seyyathā'pi, vāhana, uppalaṃ vā padumaṃ vā puṇḍarīkaṃ vā udake jātaṃ udake saṃvaḍḍhaṃ udakā paccuggamma ṭhitaṃ anupalittaṃ udakena.

46586.meaning1: fragrant mango tree; white mango; Mangifera indica

examples.text: sikhī, bhikkhave, bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho puṇḍarīkassa mūle abhisambuddho.

46589.meaning1: one of the four treasures of a Bodhisatta

examples.text: tathāgatassa pana jātadivase'y'eva saṅkho, elo, uppalo, puṇḍarīko'ti cattāro nidhayo uggatā. tesu saṅkho gāvutiko, elo aḍḍhayojaniko, uppalo tigāvutiko, puṇḍarīko yojaniko. tesu'pi gahitaṃ gahitaṃ pūrati'y'eva, iti bhagavā pahūtaṃ hiraññasuvaṇṇaṃ ohāya pabbajito'ti veditabbo.
seyyathā'pi bhikkhave uppaliniyaṃ vā paduminiyaṃ vā puṇḍarīkiniyaṃ vā app'ekaccāni uppalāni vā padumāni vā puṇḍarīkāni vā

46591.grammar: pp of pūrati, in comps (+instr or +gen)

examples.text: disvāna taṇhaṃ aratiṃ ragañ'ca, n'āhosi chando api methunasmiṃ, kim'ev'idaṃ muttakarīsapuṇṇaṃ, pādā'pi naṃ samphusituṃ na icche.
catucakkaṃ navadvāraṃ, puṇṇaṃ lobhena saṃyutaṃ, paṅkajātaṃ mahāvīra, kathaṃ yātrā bhavissatī'ti.

46592.commentary: (SNPa) puṇṇāya puṇṇamāya rattiyā'ti pannarasadivasattā divasagaṇanāya abbh'ādi-upakkilesa-virahattā rattiguṇasampattiyā ca puṇṇattā puṇṇāya, paripuṇṇacandattā puṇṇamāya ca rattiyā.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena bhagavā tadah'uposathe pannarase puṇṇāya puṇṇamāya rattiyā bhikkhusaṅghaparivuto abbhokāse nisinno hoti.
kiṃ ummatto'si, nanu idān'eva divākaro atthaṅ'gato, so kathaṃ imaṃ puṇṇacandaṃ anubandhamāno uggacchissati?

46593.meaning1: name of a Sakyan arahant monk; great disciple of the Buddha; foremost monk in giving Dhamma talks; Puṇṇa Mantāṇiputta
46593.commentary: (MNa) puṇṇo'ti tassa therassa nāmaṃ. (AN1.196) etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ dhammakathikānaṃ yadidaṃ puṇṇo mantāṇiputto.
46593.notes: Theragāthā verse 4 (TH1.4, TH4) is attributed to him.

examples.text: puṇṇo nāma, bhante, āyasmā mantāṇiputto jātibhūmiyaṃ jātibhūmakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ evaṃ sambhāvito, attanā ca app'iccho app'icchakathañ'ca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā

evaṃ vutte, āyasmā sāriputto āyasmantaṃ puṇṇaṃ mantāṇiputtaṃ etadavoca, konāmo āyasmā, kathañ'ca pan'āyasmantaṃ sabrahmacārī jānantī'ti? puṇṇo'ti kho me, āvuso, nāmaṃ, mantāṇiputto'ti ca pana maṃ sabrahmacārī jānantī'ti.

46594.meaning1: name of an arahant monk from Sunāparanta; Puṇṇa Sunāparanta
46594.commentary: (THa) so tena puññakammena devamanussesu saṃsaranto imasmiṃ buddh'uppāde sunāparantajanapade suppārakapaṭṭane gahapatikule nibbatti, puṇṇo'ti'ssa nāmaṃ ahosi. so vayappatto vāṇijjavasena mahatā satthena saddhiṃ sāvatthiṃ gato. tena ca samayena bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati. atha so sāvatthivāsīhi upāsakehi saddhiṃ vihāraṃ gato satthu santike dhammaṃ sutvā paṭiladdhasaddho pabbajitvā vattapaṭivattehi ācariy'upajjhāye ārādhento vihāsi.
46594.notes: Theragāthā verse 70 (TH1.70, TH70) is attributed to him.

examples.text: caṇḍā kho, puṇṇa, sunāparantakā manussā, pharusā kho, puṇṇa, sunāparantakā manussā. sace taṃ, puṇṇa, sunāparantakā manussā akkosissanti paribhāsissanti, tatra te, puṇṇa, kin'ti bhavissatī'ti?

46595.meaning1: name of a Koliyan ascetic who performed the cow practice

examples.text: atha kho puṇṇo ca koliyaputto govatiko acelo ca seniyo kukkuravatiko yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā puṇṇo koliyaputto govatiko bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdi.
sātāgiro hemavato, puṇṇako karatiyo guḷo, sivako mucalindo ca, vessāmitto yugan'dharo.
idañ'ca pana m'etaṃ, bhikkhave, sandhāya bhāsitaṃ pārāyane puṇṇakapañhe.
